title: 30A East The Good Life Inlet Beach, FL Stay at 30A Vacation Rentals
meta_description: Top Reasons to Book this Fabulous Townhouse!* Steps from The Big Chill* 4-Seat Gas Golf Cart Included – Conveniently explore 30A and make trips to the beach a...
description_expanded: Overview5.0(6 reviews)Top Reasons to Book this Fabulous Townhouse!* Steps from The Big Chill* 4-Seat Gas Golf Cart Included – Conveniently explore 30A and make trips to the beach a breeze* Two Resort-Style Community Pools – Including a seasonally heated North Pool* Beach Gear Included – Golf cart, wagon, 4 beach chairs, and 2 umbrellas are provided* Peaceful Forest View – Enjoy a serene setting at the end of a quiet cul-de-sac* Outdoor Patio – Relax outside at the patio table after a day of beach adventures* Pack-n-Play Available – Convenient for families traveling with little ones* Seasonal Shuttle Access – Enjoy added convenience getting around the area* Close to Deer Lake State Park – Explore the natural beauty and pristine beaches of the area* Professionally Managed; 24/7 Service*This property is NOT AVAILABLE for rent to those under the age of 25. No Exceptions. **Smart home technology is used to help ensure policy compliance and may include remotely monitored thermostats, door locks, a decibel meter, and video surveillance, including the front door. **We LOVE Snowbirds! Low Monthly Winter Rates*Snowbird Season runs November thru February, on a monthly basis. To prepare a qualified quote, select your arrival date (must be the 1st day of the month) and the departure date (must be the 1st day of the month). Alternate dates must be pre-approved. All monthly rentals are subject to an additional $150 cleaning fee. Please contact us with your interest and to further assist!Welcome to The Good Life, a stylish 2-bedroom, 2-bathroom townhouse located in the heart of Prominence on 30A! Comfortably sleeping up to five guests, this modern retreat is the perfect choice for couples or small families. One of the best features of The Good Life is its incredible location. You'll be just steps from The Big Chill, one of 30A's favorite gathering spots for live music, sports, shopping, dining, and entertainment. Inside, the open-concept living space creates a comfortable place for everyone to gather. The fully equipped kitchen includes bar seating, while the dining table comfortably seats five. Entertainment is easy with three Smart TVs featuring YouTube TV, including a 65" TV in the family room and 55" TVs in both bedrooms. Thoughtfully appointed bedrooms provide a comfortable place to relax after a day spent exploring the beach and 30A. Whether you're relaxing by the pool, enjoying live music at The Big Chill, cruising around 30A in the golf cart, or spending the day at the beach, The Good Life puts you right in the middle of everything while still giving you a peaceful place to unwind.The Bed Setup:Master Bedroom: King BedGuest Bedroom: Queen BedAdditional Sleeping: Pack-n-Play availableArea Attractions:Rosemary Beach is only minutes away, with shops and restaurants, including the Old World-style town center w/coffee shop, bike and surf rentals, and unique shops. Check out the open-air markets on the weekends. Enjoy the beautiful sugar-white sand beaches that made 30A world famous. Enjoy walking and biking everywhere around Rosemary, Seacrest, and Alys Beach. Don't miss the newly opened 30Avenue for even more dining and shopping options. 30Avenue is just north of Rosemary across Hwy 98, near both Shades Sports Bar and The Donut Hole. This laid-back, fun family atmosphere awaits you! Come stay and play and see for yourself what makes our community and the 30A area so special! The snorkelers in your group will love the new artificial reef called Grouper Reef, deployed in 2017. Located just 970 feet out from the Inlet Beach access, it is becoming a haven for sea life. Each of the 4 snorkeling reefs comprises 40 acres of permitted sea bottom. The Grouper Reef is at a depth of 12-21 feet. We strongly recommend that snorkelers use a kayak, paddleboard, or other flotation device when visiting the snorkel reefs. Sea conditions can and do change quickly and often. Enjoy!Show less
